name: Google Workspace

name: Redis
prerequisites: uv and a reachable Redis URL; credentials/TLS settings where required.

name: MongoDB
prerequisites: Node.js and a reachable MongoDB deployment with appropriate database credentials.

name: Elasticsearch
prerequisites: Docker daemon access and Elasticsearch URL/API key.
validation: configuration and runtime regression fixtures; live account operations not verified

name: Puppeteer
prerequisites: Archived reference implementation; Node.js, compatible Chrome/Chromium, and browser system libraries. Prefer a maintained browser server for new deployments.
validation: Import/runtime regression tests and a real browser tool call passed on Linux with installed Chromium and Node.js. Puppeteer test used its documented headless launch option. This does not validate all tools or all platforms.

validation: configuration and runtime regression fixtures; live account operations not verified

name: Microsoft 365

validation: configuration and runtime regression fixtures; live account operations not verified

name: X (Twitter)
